title: electedBR 0.1.0
text: First CRAN release. Election results read yearly Parquet files derived TSE open data hosted Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/mlkwy/electedBR), indexed new elected_years dataset. first query year downloads 1 25 MB user cache; electionsBR longer dependency multi-hundred-megabyte TSE downloads gone. normalize_elected() remains exported function builds files. get_elected() covers mayors, deputy mayors councilors (2020, 2024) senators federal, state district deputies (2018, 2022); office defaults every office year. base_url / option electedBR.base_url select mirror. New elected_clear_cache(). Sitting federal deputies senators official open data APIs (get_deputies(), get_senators()) per-member service history (get_service_history()), six-hour configurable cache immutable local snapshots; failed collection never returns expired data silently. Every function returns tibble English columns Portuguese alias (consultar_eleitos(), consultar_prefeitos(), consultar_vereadores(), consultar_deputados(), consultar_senadores(), consultar_historico_exercicio(), normalizar_eleitos(), limpar_cache_eleitos()). bare aliases eleitos(), prefeitos() vereadores() prototype removed. Error messages English; roxygen2 documentation, pkgdown site offline test suite.
